Family dinner
May 2026 • Family
We had a family dinner at Lac Thai and overall had a very enjoyable experience. Out of the 10 dishes we ordered, 9 were excellent and full of flavor. The only disappointment was the beef dish, which was unfortunately too tough to eat.
The food overall was delicious, and the service made the experience even better. Tien did a wonderful job taking care of our table. She was attentive, friendly, and provided great service throughout the meal.
Despite one dish not meeting expectations, we left happy and satisfied. We would definitely return to try more of the menu.
A solid dining experience with great food and excellent service from Tien. ⭐⭐⭐⭐
